messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Please reply with **one** of the following so I can locate your user profile:
1) **Email address**, or  
2) **First name + Last name + ZIP code**

Also, if you already know it, share the **order id(s)** for the gaming-related purchase(s) (e.g., `#W0000000`).
